mostWorthwhile.text: Building water step by step on a grain was most worthwhile: the hydroxyl intermediate clarified how the surface helps atoms meet and water ice form.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the ice-mantled dust with the cloud and then inspecting the cloud was a little repetitive; neither revealed a usable next operation.

surprise.text: I was surprised that cold dust surfaces also helped hydrogen molecules form, a different route from the dust-free chemistry of the first stars.

arbitrary.text: The ice-mantled dust could not combine with the cloud despite seeming relevant to gathering it; that restriction was not clear from the result.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the cold cloud toward a planetary system, especially after seeing how grain surfaces help make water and molecular hydrogen.
